entry.title: I Built a Modern Disk Cleaner as a Solo Dev — Here's What I Learned
entry.summary:
## Why I Built Disk Mop I've been using CCleaner for years, but after the Avast acquisition it became bloated and lost user trust. CleanMyMac is great but costs $40+/year and only works on Mac. I wanted something modern, fast, cross-platform, and affordable. So I built it myself. ## What is Disk Mop? Disk Mop is a desktop app for Windows and macOS that helps you clean, optimize, and analyze your disk space. ## Features 🧹 Browser Cache Cleaner — Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Safari 🔍 Duplicate File Finder — hash-based exact matching 🖼️ Visual Duplicate Finder — perceptual hash for similar photos 📊 Disk Treemap — interactive visualization of disk usage 📁 Large File Scanner — find space hogs instantly 📂 Empty Folder Finder — clean up clutter 🚀 Startup Manager — control what runs at boot 🔒 File Shredder — secure deletion (DoD 5220.22-M) 💾 Disk Health — SMART data monitoring 🧠 RAM Optimizer — free up memory ⚙️ Service Manager — manage background services 📋 Privacy Report — see what's tracking you 🗑️ Recycle Bin & Downloads Cleaner
🌐 DNS Cache Flush
## Tech Stack Electron 31 + React 18 + Vite
TypeScript for type safety Tailwind CSS v4 for styling Zustand for state management electron-updater for auto-updates Custom IPC streaming for real-time progress events ## Architecture The app follows a clean IPC pattern: ipcMain.handle for request/response webContents.send for streaming progress events Preload bridge with contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld
Platform-specific code paths for Windows and macOS ## Pricing Core features are completely free. PRO unlocks 20+ advanced tools for a one-time $19.90 — no subscriptions, no recurring fees. ## What's Next Scheduled cleanup with Windows Task Scheduler More languages (French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese) Yearly pricing option Linux support (maybe?) ## Try It Out 🔗 diskmop.com I'd love to hear your feedback. entry.title: Why Your AI Voiceovers Sounds Robotic (And How to Fix Them)
entry.summary:
You've perfected your script and video edit. You generate an AI voiceover and get disappointed. The words are correct, but something sounds off; flat pacing, wrong emphasis, and your brand name mangled beyond recognition. The problem isn't the AI model. It's the lack of direction.
Most text-to-speech (TTS) models work by predicting the statistically average way to say a word. They don't understand emotional weight. They don't know that "The house burned down" should sound different from "The toast burned down." Three main issues: Lack of prosody: AI maintains flat pitch instead of varying it like humans do to signal meaning. No natural breathing: Humans pause for breath. AI doesn't.
